arrowWood.note: in flight: points along +x; turn it to the flight angle (atan2(sin*K, cos)), as drawProj does

arrowWoodGround_0.note: stuck in the turf, steep; the foot point where it went in

arrowWoodGround_1.note: stuck in the turf, low; flip it for an arrow from the other side

arrowWoodWall.note: stuck in a wall or tree facing the eye; the foot point where it went in; flip for the other side

arrows_wood.note: the item icon, 160 px: the bundle along x; the game lays it across the slot's diagonal
